name: 86 Chaos 16.0.210
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.210
notes: Converted expected presence-summary RTDB timeouts to an explicit degraded/retryable non-5xx response while preserving the bounded timeout.
Corrected Back Office tab semantics with a valid tablist while preserving tab controls and behavior.
Repaired release-gate navigation, Document Vault, form-control, schedule-readiness, and responsive-matrix harness determinism without reducing coverage.
Preserved 16.0.201 Firebase cost optimizations and kept Firestore/RTDB read/write behavior flat.
Migrated legacy failed+new responsive matrix lineage to the five viewport-partitioned tests so the exact gate runs instead of blocking on the retired monolithic title.
Added Schedule Builder seed visibility retry-on-fresh-route behavior for the release gate without accepting empty data.
Tagged inventoried form controls during the exhaustive harness probe so fill/restore targets the exact visible element instead of a drifting structural ordinal.
Corrected the reported-failed-only Playwright selection guard to accept the actual six selected legacy failure identities: two chromium and four mobile-chromium.
Kept the failed-only guard strict: zero-test selections, duplicate identities, unexpected projects, timeouts, and new/repair reasons still fail before Playwright can produce a false green.

Fixed failed-only result collection reconciliation so Playwright-reported titles that include the spec file prefix match the exact manifest identity instead of turning a 6/6 pass into a failed report.
Repaired failed+new delta gate workspace chooser/version assertion readiness so tests do not assert app version while still on the workspace picker.
Repaired nested state control lookup to choose the first visible matching tab/button instead of being trapped by hidden duplicates, restoring QuickBooks Back Office coverage.
Converted Schedule Builder tool controls to a valid tablist/tab ARIA structure and extended the seed-hydration test budget without adding app reads.
Optimized exhaustive delta traversal by de-duplicating repeated form/mutation probes and avoiding redundant same-route transitions while still visiting every declared route/state.
Hardened release-gate login so mobile Chromium retries one no-op submit and fails with an explicit login readiness error instead of misreporting Schedule Builder seed labels.
Opened responsive System Administrator directory controls before declaring GodMode nested states missing, fixing mobile nested accessibility coverage without skipping states.
Reduced redundant per-state form/mutation/click probes in exhaustive graph traversal while still visiting every declared route/state and observing controls.
Made the Full Schedule scroll list keyboard-focusable and increased contrast for muted past-shift chips, Burn Log Review, and critical maintenance labels.
Corrected the tablet tap-target harness classification so 768px tablet layout uses normal AA target floor while phone-sized viewports keep the stricter 42px touch policy.
Updated the Schedule Request Off focused test helper to use the current Warnings tab semantics instead of the retired button-only selector.
Allowed visible current-workspace Request Off rows without legacy workspace metadata to remain eligible for bulk archive/approve while still rejecting explicit wrong-workspace rows.
Aligned the focused Request Off test clock with the seeded restaurant anchor and made readiness wait for the actual employee request card instead of matching the employee dropdown.
